walkthrough.short: {chains} take right hands in the middle, pull by, and courtesy turn with the lark across the set.
walkthrough.long: {chains} take right hands in the middle, pull by, and carry on across the set. The lark you come to turns about and steps off his place to meet you: your left hand in his left, his right hand on your back. He walks backward, you walk forward, half round, and the couple opens out facing in. {where}
